Reads: harness OpenCodeSessionReader.locatePrompt(ref, messageId, sourceVersion==2.0.22, maxHistoryPages=5) -> GET inbox (raw rows, bounded 4096, duplicate ids rejected; exact id match: type user + payload.text + delivery equal -> pending; other -> occupied), then GET message?order=desc&limit=200 following native cursor (no order with cursor); id match type user -> promoted, other type -> occupied; complete when a page has fewer rows than the limit or next==null (2.0.22 asc final page still returns next); full pages beyond max -> incomplete. Never message.get; no created-time/ordinal early stop (promotion order != id order). Read failures throw OpenCodeSessionReadException -> entry stays uncertain. Store: OpenCodePromptOutbox gains required reader + wait(Duration) (default Future.delayed); reconcile(session, commandId, {cancellation}) -> OutboxReconciliation{entry?, refusal?, posts}; concrete setCancellationFence (not on port; V2-045D). Records additive in schema 1: replays (0..3), fence (name, default none), notBefore (ISO). Loop: each step under the per-session lock re-reads ledger (+_recover); only uncertain proceeds; record.connectedVersion must equal client's; lookup; pending -> admitted, promoted -> delivered, occupied -> uncertain identityOccupied, incomplete -> uncertain historyIncomplete; absent -> stop if fence!=none, replays>=3 (replayExhausted), now<notBefore (backoff); else prepare from record fields + evaluate(contract phase initial, verifiedUnresolvedAdmission, evidence B prompt-matrix, admission unresolved, reconciled true, fence) -> persist sending replays+1 notBefore=now+[1s,2s,4s][replays-1] (persist fail -> no POST) -> post -> admitted/rejected/uncertain, !posted keeps uncertain. Lock released between steps; wait until notBefore then loop while still uncertain, replays<3 and not cancelled. Eviction also drops delivered. Count: 3 same-id replays after the original POST.
